On physical exam, his knee is erythematous, tender, and swollen, with a limited range of motion. Arthrocentesis aspirates frank blood from the joint.                     ### Question

The evidence paths regarding arthrocentesis and its association with hemophilic arthropathy further support the likelihood of a bleeding disorder affecting the intrinsic pathway, making PTT the most likely abnormal test in this patient.
